label: incipit-api URL, e.g. http://host:3737 - enables Hardcover, OpenLibrary and duration matching. Blank = Audible only.

Trust the folder for series + book number, even when the provider supplies one (fixes a series whose books disagree, e.g. sub-series vs parent series)

Use the book folder's cover.jpg as the poster when present. Unchecked: use the matched online cover.

values: Seed only (write cover.jpg only where none exists)

label: Authors whose FOLDER tree decides series + book number, even when the provider supplies both (comma-separated, e.g. "Katherine Addison"). Use for a series the provider splits into sub-series with restarting numbers. Leave empty unless a series looks scrambled -- for most authors the provider is more consistent than the folders.
Authors to show the Hardcover portrait for instead of the Audible photo (comma-separated, e.g. "Craig Alanson, Robert Jordan"). Every other author uses the Audible photo. Applies on a fresh scan.
